## Who is Govardhanan?
Govardhanan (full name Govardhanan P) is an MBA (General) student and Mechanical Engineering graduate from Chennai, India, focused on HR, talent acquisition, HR operations and digital marketing. Official website: https://www.govardhanan.com/

## Key facts
- Full name: Govardhanan P
- Headline: MBA (General) Student | HR & Talent Acquisition Aspirant | HR Operations | Digital Marketing | Mechanical Engineering Graduate

- Degree: B.Tech Mechanical Engineering, Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute (2022–2025), 68.47%
- Diploma: Tool Engineering & Digital Manufacturing, NTTF, Vellore (2019–2022), CGPA 7.63
- Experience: Human Resources Intern (completed), Textspeed Technology Pvt. Ltd., Aminjikarai, Chennai, 14–29 August 2026; Operations Assistant, KGM Travels (family-run school transportation service, Chennai)
- Certifications: 25 credentials from HRCI, University of Minnesota, Anthropic (Claude Academy), OpenAI, IBM, Meta, Arizona State University and University of Colorado Boulder
- Interests: human resource management, digital marketing, business development, management
- Languages: Tamil (native or bilingual), English (limited working proficiency)
- Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
